messages:
perf-bot: [ALERT] nightly-canary job ci-nightly/4109876543 p95 latency 620ms -> automatic fallback to model-variant small-quant triggered. Canary: canary-west-3a-42. See job: https://ci.redwood/internal/job/ci-nightly/4109876543

sara: ugh, saw the alert. who can own triage for a few hours? I can check traces in ~30m.

aj: I can run a quick sampling now, can you paste the canary id and commit?

perf-bot: canary_id: canary-west-3a-42, commit: abc1234ef, fallback_target: gpt-small-quant, autoscaling: on, routing policy: cost-first.

kevin: I can grab this — taking ownership. plan: 1) collect traces (pprof/kv traces) 2) scrape logs + kernel scheduler snapshot 3) force routing override to stable-large to validate fallback impact.

sara: thx kevin. for traces use --sample 200 if possible. small sample misses the tail.

aj: running quick data pull now. command:```./infra/tools/collect-trace --job ci-nightly --canary canary-west-3a-42 --sample 200 --out /tmp/trace-4109876543.zip```

aj: grabbed initial histogram. p50 ~140ms, p90 ~320ms, p95 ~610ms. tail is dominated by model-load stalls.

morgan: fyi there was a config change in abc1234ef that enabled aggressive batching prefetch. might interact with kv cache eviction. filing note.

kevin: pulling logs. snippet: ```[2026-03-18T02:12:34Z] model_loader.cpp: CacheMiss ratio=0.87 seq_len=1280 load_time_ms=420
[2026-03-18T02:12:35Z] kv_cache.cpp: eviction=true cost=0.003 mem=92%```

kevin: looks like large seqs + eviction causing expensive model layer loads on fallback. trying a quick routing override to confirm.

kevin: applying temporary override:```kubectl patch deploy canary-west-3a-42 -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"routing-override":"force-large"}}}}}'```

oncall-bot: Routing override applied by kevin at 02:23 UTC. Keep an eye on canary health: https://canary.redwood/status/canary-west-3a-42

sara: running the same sampling after override...

aj: post-override sample p95 -> 270ms, p99 -> 420ms. tail improved significantly. :eyes:

morgan: that aligns with the hypothesis. aggressive prefetch + small-quant variant increases loads mid-run. we should either increase kv cache or adjust prefetch policy.

kevin: capturing artifacts and uploading: /artifacts/ci-nightly/4109876543/trace.zip and logs.tar.gz. Will open follow-up ticket INF-2345 to revert or tune prefetch and add a perf test for canary fallback.

sara: can you also add a quick alert suppression for this job while we patch? don't want repeat paging.

oncall-bot: Alert suppression request noted. Suppression window set for 30m.

aj: quick note — kernel scheduler showed a short burst of kernel CPU stalls when eviction happened, posix locks aligned with loader threads. adding to ticket.

kevin: thanks all. owner=kevin, next actions in INF-2345: (1) revert prefetch toggle on canary, (2) add kv cache WIP limit, (3) add perf regression test that exercises fallback path. I'll assign and ping tomorrow.

morgan: also adding a postmortem-lite doc to the ticket with traces + commands to reproduce locally.

sara: closing loop here — post-override the canary is stable. thanks for the quick turn. :thumbsup:

kevin: closing thread, leaving notes in INF-2345 and scheduling a follow-up sync with infra tomorrow 10am PT.
